params.name: level
params.description: Block height at which you want to know account balance

items.docs:
Returns account balance* at the specified block.  
\* - for non-baker tz-accounts historical balances do not include staked tez,
because stakers do not really have staked tez on their balance, they have staking pseudotokens instead.
If you want to get a full historical balance, including staked tez, use the Tezos node RPC:
`/chains/main/blocks/{level}/context/contracts/{address}/full_balance`.

items.docs:
Returns time series with historical balances* (only changes, without duplicates).  
\* - for non-baker tz-accounts historical balances do not include staked tez,
because stakers do not really have staked tez on their balance, they have staking pseudotokens instead.
If you want to get a full historical balance, including staked tez, use the Tezos node RPC:
`/chains/main/blocks/{level}/context/contracts/{address}/full_balance`.

params.description: Account address (starting with tz or KT)

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the datetime range to filter by (ISO 8601, e.g. 2019-11-31)

params.name: to
params.description: End of the datetime range to filter by (ISO 8601, e.g. 2019-12-31)

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency to convert amounts to (`btc`, `eur`, `usd`, `cny`, `jpy`, `krw`, `eth`, `gbp`)

params.name: historical
params.description: `true` if you want to use historical prices, `false` to use current price

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Column delimiter (`comma`, `semicolon`)
